punchline: Four novels came from one small house in five years.
thirty_sec: Jane Austen moved to Chawton on 7 July 1809, revised Sense and Sensibility and Pride and Prejudice there, and wrote Mansfield Park, Emma and Persuasion; four novels were published between 1811 and 1815.
question: Where and when could you work every day on the same one or two projects?
key_contrast: A settled place and routine, not a heroic week.
